items.title: Archer raises $10M to expand AI tools for candidates and recruiters
items.summary: Volition Capital led a $10M round; a candidate agent launches in January and Archer OS for TA teams in Q1 2027.

items.title: Workday asks court to decertify the Mobley age-bias collective
items.summary: Workday argues employers configure and decide independently, so claims need individual review; hearing set for 9 March 2027.

items.title: Metaview raises $60M Series C led by Insight Partners
items.summary: Agentic recruiting company funds expansion of agents that source, screen and summarise candidates.
